designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.intro: Every piece the app is built from, with the code to use it. Colors come from the logo: blue for mentors, green for mentees.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Each scale is sampled from the logo. Use 600 or darker for text and buttons on white, lighter steps for tints.

roles.title: Role colors
roles.description: Color says whose feature it is. Mentor features take blue, mentee features green, shared ones teal.

perch.title: Perch
perch.description: The branch both birds stand on. The only gradient in the app: use it once per screen at most.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: One family, Lexend. Sentence case everywhere, no all-caps labels.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: Solid fills, no gradients. Name the button after what it does: "Save", not "Submit".

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: The label and helper text are linked to the field. Error text says what is wrong and how to fix it.

textarea.title: Text area
textarea.description: Same options as Input, without icons or sizes. The user can resize it vertically.

select.title: Select
select.description: A native select with a required label. Use it for short, fixed lists.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: A native checkbox. The whole label is clickable.

languageToggle.title: Language toggle
languageToggle.description: Switches the interface language and remembers the choice.

roleBird.title: Role bird
roleBird.description: The bird for a role, cropped from the logo. Decorative: always put the role name next to it.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Line icons with a 1.75 stroke. Use them instead of emoji.

type.pageTitleSample: Find a mentor who has walked your path

programme.title: The programme
programme.body: Mentor-Mentee is a free, voluntary mentoring programme for health professionals and students. The coordination forms the pairs, follows the mentorships and issues the certificates.

data.title: Data we collect
data.body: Your account e-mail and password, and your profile answers: name, date of birth, gender, country and city, languages, education, profession, interest areas, contacts, preferences and open answers.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To form pairs, contact you about the programme, follow the mentorships and issue certificates. We do not sell or share your data with third parties.

access.title: Who sees your data
access.body: Only the coordination sees your full profile. Your name and contacts are given to your pair only after you both accept the mentorship.

research.title: Research (optional)
research.body: If you allow it, your answers and evaluations may be used in research, always without identifying you. Without your permission, nothing of yours goes into research. You can change this choice in your profile at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can see and correct your data in your profile, and ask the coordination to delete it or end your participation.

conduct.title: Taking part
conduct.body: Mentor and mentee treat each other with respect and keep their conversations confidential. Either can end the mentorship with two weeks' written notice.
